_comment: Alert -> specialist routing. Engine-failure alerts are NOT here: they're
matched by alert_parser.is_engine_failure_rate() (a precise regex), not a
keyword list, since 'engine failure rate' alert titles vary too much for a
plain substring match to be safe either way.
Everything below is a case-insensitive substring match against the alert's
alertname/incident_name/raw_text. First specialist whose keyword list has a
hit wins. No match -> generalist fallback (case-library + Slack history,
no domain tool) rather than a wrong guess.
Editable without touching code, same spirit as data/cases.json and
config/panel_map.json — add a keyword here as new alert types are learned.

2026-09-11: keywords below the original set were added from a scan of the real #alerts-devops and #comms-noc history. NodeHighCPUUsage was the single most frequent VictorOps pager in that window and had no route at all. 'IS DOWN' is deliberately broad but only matches the Zabbix/PandoLogic titles ('10.60.4.178 IPrediction IS DOWN'); it is last in its list so a more specific route still wins.

keywords: WCF Service Not In Running State
